paragraphs: The official rate fell from 13001.8417057 on 19 Oct 2025 to 11057.06241739 on 22 Oct 2025. That was a fall of 14.9577% in Syrian pounds per dollar. Our code spotted the change on 22 Oct, using history files and not our live collectors. The rate was 11057.58740791 on 17 Dec 2025, which was 14.9537% below the old level.
We found no announcement for that date.
